name: ComponentDefaults
description: Utility provider that sets the default control size for every control below it.

controlSize.description: Default size for controls that do not pass their own size prop

value.description: Full defaults object; explicit controlSize wins over value.controlSize

when: A region needs every control at one size (dense table toolbars, compact sidebars)
A ThemeProvider subtree should default to sm or lg controls
whenNot: Sizing a single control (pass its size prop)
Changing spacing or typography (use tokens, not control size)
guidelines: Renders no chrome: it only supplies context read through useResolvedControlSize
Nest providers to override the size for a smaller region
An explicit size prop on a control always wins over the provider default
ThemeProvider componentDefaults wires this provider for you at the root
accessibility: sm controls still meet the kit's minimum target size through the action recipe

examples.name: Dense Toolbar
examples.description: Every control in the toolbar defaults to sm without repeating the prop.

examples.name: Nested Override
examples.description: A nested provider narrows the default for one region.
examples.code:
<ComponentDefaultsProvider controlSize="lg">
  <Button>Large by default</Button>
  <ComponentDefaultsProvider controlSize="sm">
    <Button>Small in this region</Button>
  </ComponentDefaultsProvider>
</ComponentDefaultsProvider>

relations.note: ThemeProvider accepts componentDefaults and mounts this provider
Controls resolve their size through useResolvedControlSize

propsSummary: controlSize: sm|md|lg - default size for controls below the provider
value: { controlSize } - defaults object, explicit controlSize wins
